enabled.description: Enable the I2P daemon to start automatically at boot.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity. Choices: none, error, warn, info, debug, trace, debuglog.

log_file.description: Path to the I2P daemon log file. Empty string disables file logging.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file. Empty string disables PID file creation.

data_directory.description: Directory where I2P stores keys, router info, and tunnel data.

host.description: Network interface to bind internal services (HTTP, SAM, etc.).

http_port.description: Port for the HTTP API/web console (e.g., http://localhost:7070).

https_port.description: Port for HTTPS API (optional). Set to 0 to disable.

sam_port.description: Port for SAM (Simple Anonymous Messaging) bridge, used by applications.

i2pcontrol_port.description: Port for I2PControl (remote management protocol). Enable only if needed.

i2pcontrol_certfile.description: TLS certificate path for I2PControl (required when enabled).

i2pcontrol_keyfile.description: TLS private key path for I2PControl.

bandwidth_limit_up.description: Upload bandwidth limit in KB/s (0 = unlimited).

bandwidth_limit_down.description: Download bandwidth limit in KB/s (0 = unlimited).

client_tunnel_count.description: Maximum number of client (short) tunnels to build.

transit_tunnel_count.description: Maximum number of transit (long) tunnels to build.

transit_enabled.description: Allow this node to forward traffic for others (acts as network transit). Disable for privacy-focused clients.

floodfill_enabled.description: Enable floodfill role — store and publish router info for the network. Only enable if you have static IP and high uptime.

reserved_peers.description: List of reserved (preferred) peers. Each entry is a peer name and destination base64.

name.description: Friendly name of the reserved peer.

destination.description: Base64-encoded router identity hash (destination) of the peer.

reserved_ips.description: List of reserved IP:port entries to prefer for connections (e.g., bootstrap or known good nodes).

port.description: Port to connect to on this host.

trusted_ips.description: List of IPs to trust (e.g., your own nodes or relays). Bypasses some rate limiting.

addressbooks.description: URLs of public address books to fetch known hosts. Add custom ones as needed.
